figs.name: bimetallic-thermometer-specification-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for specifying a bimetallic thermometer range, silicone filling, thermowell and stem
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog walking through the article advice: transmitter for remote signals, mid scale range, silicone fill for vibration, a thermowell and full helix immersion.
figs.after_h2: Bimetallic Thermometer Standards and Accuracy Classes
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for specifying a bimetallic thermometer</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Specifying a Bimetallic Thermometer</text>
<polygon points="400,64.0 570.0,110 400,156.0 230.0,110" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="105.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Must the reading</text>
<text x="400" y="127.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">reach the DCS?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="110" x2="610" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="96" font-size="17" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="612" y="74" width="170" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="104.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use a temperature</text>
<text x="697.0" y="127.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">transmitter</text>
<line x1="400" y1="156" x2="400" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="172" font-size="17" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No, local dial</text>
<rect x="220" y="180" width="360" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="213.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pick range with normal value mid scale</text>
<line x1="400" y1="236" x2="400" y2="256" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,258.0 570.0,304 400,350.0 230.0,304" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="299.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pumps or compressors</text>
<text x="400" y="321.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">shaking the pointer?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="304" x2="610" y2="304" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="290" font-size="17" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="612" y="264" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#b91c1c" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="298.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Silicone fill,</text>
<text x="697.0" y="321.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">case below 250 °C</text>
<line x1="400" y1="350" x2="400" y2="374" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="220" y="374" width="360" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="408.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mount in a thermowell</text>
<line x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="450" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="450" width="360" height="64" rx="10" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="476.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Stem long enough to fully</text>
<text x="400.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">immerse the helix</text>
<polyline points="697,344 697,402 582,402" fill="none" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="552" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Check class 1 or 2 to EN 13190 and verify yearly in a dry block</text>
</svg>

figs.name: bimetallic-thermometer-strip-deflection-infographic
figs.alt: bimetallic thermometer strip deflection worked example, brass on Invar, 3.34 mm at 100 K
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working the article example: brass on Invar, 1 mm thick and 50 mm long, curls to R 374.5 mm and deflects 3.34 mm for a 100 K rise.
figs.after_h2: Deflection of a Straight Bimetal Strip
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Deflection of a straight bimetal strip worked example</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Straight Strip Deflection: Brass on Invar</text>
<rect x="60" y="100" width="40" height="120" fill="#475569"/>
<rect x="100" y="146" width="300" height="10" fill="#f59e0b"/><rect x="100" y="156" width="300" height="10" fill="#94a3b8"/>
<path d="M100 146 Q260 146 395 170 L393 180 Q260 156 100 156 Z" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.45"/>
<path d="M100 156 Q260 156 393 180 L391 190 Q260 166 100 166 Z" fill="#94a3b8" opacity="0.45"/>
<line x1="412" y1="152" x2="412" y2="186" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="422" y="176" font-size="20" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">δ</text>
<text x="250" y="214" font-size="17" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Brass on top, 19 ppm/K</text>
<text x="250" y="238" font-size="17" fill="#475569" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Invar below, 1.2 ppm/K</text>
<text x="250" y="90" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Heated: curls toward the low expansion Invar</text>
<rect x="470" y="80" width="310" height="160" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625" y="116" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ΔT = 100 K</text>
<text x="625" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">t = 1 mm total</text>
<text x="625" y="184" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L = 50 mm free length</text>
<text x="625" y="218" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equal layers and modulus</text>
<rect x="20" y="270" width="760" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="308" font-size="20" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1/R = 3 × (α1 − α2) × ΔT ÷ (2 × t)</text>
<text x="400" y="344" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 3 × 0.0000178 × 100 ÷ 2 = 0.00267 per mm, R = 374.5 mm</text>
<text x="400" y="390" font-size="20" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">δ ≈ L² ÷ (2 × R)</text>
<text x="400" y="426" font-size="20" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 2500 ÷ (2 × 374.5) = 3.34 mm</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Only 3.34 mm for a 100 K rise, so real gauges coil a long strip</text>
<text x="400" y="528" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">into a helix that turns the pointer</text>
</svg>
